chapters.name: The Sealed Corridor
chapters.intro: The castle has a wing missing from every map. Tonight, a silver serpent appears on the wall and points toward a door that was never there.
chapters.outro: The castle has kept a secret for centuries. You are about to find out why.

chapters.name: The Library of Lies
chapters.intro: Every book tells a different version of the same event. One of them is telling the truth, and the others are trying to keep you from it.
chapters.outro: Some lies are written in ink. Others are written in what has been erased.

chapters.name: The Glass Conservatory
chapters.intro: Beneath moonlit glass, the castle grows plants that should not exist. The serpent leads you toward a sealed botanical ledger.
chapters.outro: Nature is patient. Secrets, less so.

chapters.name: The Clockwork Vault
chapters.intro: The heart of the castle is a machine built to keep a promise. Its gears will not turn until you understand the pattern.
chapters.outro: A lock is only a question made of metal.

chapters.name: The Serpent’s Choice
chapters.intro: The truth is finally within reach: the serpent was never guarding a treasure. It was guarding a decision.
chapters.outro: Knowing the truth is one thing. Choosing what to do with it is another.
